description:
Joo Eunhye has spent her life in a strict, wealthy household where she’s always been forced to be “obedient.” She seems to be living an enviable life according to her family’s wishes, but just two years into her marriage, she witnesses her husband cheating. When she confronts him, Eunhye learns that this marriage wasn’t love—it was a “deal.” 

Afterward, at a bar she used to frequent, she meets the alluring bartender Lee Yuri. He gets by living off allowances from wealthy women he maintains secret relationships with, and on impulse, she proposes “a night” with him… 

“Are you really going to cheat with me? I’m expensive.”

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/yubunyeo_complex), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/MW_Complex)
